events.description: A person lies on the floor while multiple individuals—including police and red-vested emergency personnel—surround and physically interact with them; the prone individual shows no resistance.

verification.reason: Frames f3–f6 show a passive, non-combative individual on the ground being restrained/assisted by uniformed officers and paramedics; this satisfies 'Abuse' (aggression against a helpless victim), not 'Fighting' (which requires mutual combat). Candidate 1 is contradicted by lack of reciprocity; candidate 2 aligns and is merged.

events.description: Sustained close-quarters confrontation between riot police in green helmets and a dense crowd of civilians inside a station, involving repeated shoving, physical contact, and aggressive posturing without resolution.

verification.reason: From f8 onward, frames show escalating collective tension: civilians gesture (e.g., peace sign in f8–f10), push (f14–f16), and are pushed back by officers (f17–f22); this constitutes collective violent unrest per definition. Intervals of candidates 4, 5, and 8 overlap and form one continuous event; candidate 3 (6.5–11.5) starts earlier but lacks violence until ~8.5 (f8), so the riot begins at f8, not f7.
